candidates.formal_type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field.{u_1} K] [inst_1 : CharZero.{u_1} K] (N : Nat) (lam : Fin N → Nat) (z : K),
  (∀ (i j : Fin N),
      LT.lt.{0} i j →
        Ne.{u_1 + 1}
          (HSub.hSub.{u_1, u_1, u_1} (HPow.hPow.{u_1, 0, u_1} z (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} N 1) i.val))
            (HPow.hPow.{u_1, 0, u_1} z (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} N 1) j.val)))
          0) →
    Eq.{u_1 + 1} (DFunLike.coe.{u_1 + 1, 1, u_1 + 1} (Etingof.evalGeometricAt.{u_1} N K z) (Etingof.schurPoly N lam))
      (HDiv.hDiv.{u_1, u_1, u_1}
        (Finset.prod.{0, u_1}
          (Finset.filter.{0} (fun p => LT.lt.{0} (Prod.fst.{0, 0} p) (Prod.snd.{0, 0} p)) Finset.univ.{0}) fun p =>
          HSub.hSub.{u_1, u_1, u_1}
            (HPow.hPow.{u_1, 0, u_1} z
              (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (lam (Prod.fst.{0, 0} p)) N) 1)
                (Prod.fst.{0, 0} p).val))
            (HPow.hPow.{u_1, 0, u_1} z
              (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (lam (Prod.snd.{0, 0} p)) N) 1)
                (Prod.snd.{0, 0} p).val)))
        (Finset.prod.{0, u_1}
          (Finset.filter.{0} (fun p => LT.lt.{0} (Prod.fst.{0, 0} p) (Prod.snd.{0, 0} p)) Finset.univ.{0}) fun p =>
          HSub.hSub.{u_1, u_1, u_1}
            (HPow.hPow.{u_1, 0, u_1} z (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} N 1) (Prod.fst.{0, 0} p).val))
            (HPow.hPow.{u_1, 0, u_1} z (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} N 1) (Prod.snd.{0, 0} p).val))))

rule: Use primary exactly when the declaration itself states or defines the source claim. Use supporting for prerequisites, constructions, helper lemmas, instances, or consequences that help formalize the item but do not themselves state it.
source_text: The Schur polynomial at (1,z,...,z^(N-1)) equals the book's product quotient, including its complex and integer-exponent forms.
